description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction for two experiments, labeled "Ex1 Accuracy" and "Ex2 Accuracy," across a sequence of training steps. The x-axis represents the "Step," ranging from 0 to 60,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)," ranging from 0.10 to 0.40 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Ex1 Accuracy" is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.235 at step 0 and rising to a plateau near 0.405 by step 50,000. The "Ex2 Accuracy" is shown by a solid teal line with circular markers, beginning at 0.095 at step 0, increasing to approximately 0.275 at step 10,000, then to about 0.365 at step 20,000, and stabilizing near 0.385 from step 30,000 onwards.
